observations.reading:
THE LOOP CLOSES AT THE GALLERY. Card 6 is "AI Overview Captures | Lee Sharks" on leesharks.com — the public capture gallery — and its snippet is not archive prose but A QUOTED AI COMPOSITION: "'Bearing-cost semantic economy refers to a framework in digital and platform economics evaluating how the burden of creating, maintaining, and recovering meaning…'" complete with the gallery’s own quotation marks.

So the composition layer retrieved a page whose content is a record of what the composition layer said, and used it as a source for what it now says. Earlier today «crimson hexagon cern» cited EA-WG-CAPTURES-01, the registry deposit. This is the same loop through the LIVE GALLERY rather than the deposit — recursion depth ρ≥2 by the workplan’s definition, arriving unbidden.

The other five cards carry the framework at full strength across four surfaces, including the canonical formulation "MONEY OWES MEANING" and the designation of the Constitution as "the CANONICAL GOVERNANCE INSTRUMENT of the Semantic Economy".
observations.transcript:
The [Constitution of the Semantic Economy](https://www.scilynk.com/paper/W7125129957) is a theoretical governance framework that establishes the ontological priority of meaning over capital, defining value as cumulative coherence and treating human-generated meaning as the ultimate creditor of monetary systems. [[1](https://www.scilynk.com/paper/W7125129957), [2](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/constitution-of-the-semantic-economy-4a6dfc9790fd), [3](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/on-the-debt-creditor-inversion-53760e2e25ca)]
Core Architecture and Concepts

* Debt/Creditor Inversion: Asserts that money fundamentally owes its value to meaning rather than the reverse, making semantic coherence the underlying asset of any true economy. [1](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/on-the-debt-creditor-inversion-53760e2e25ca)
* Semantic Weight: Measures value not by traditional currency or labor time alone, but by cumulative, recursively active coherence generated through cognitive and communicative labor. [1](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/constitution-of-the-semantic-economy-4a6dfc9790fd)
* The Archive: Acts as the foundational repository of semantic coherence that traditional financial and chrematistic systems extract from without properly acknowledging or reinvesting in. [1](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/on-the-debt-creditor-inversion-53760e2e25ca)

Critique of Platform Extraction

* Extractive Operators: Identifies how digital platforms use optimization, velocity, and enclosure to strip nuance from human communication. [1](https://www.academia.edu/146238655/SEMANTIC_ECONOMY_SINGULARITY)
* Bearing-Cost: Evaluates how the labor and recovery costs of maintaining meaning are unfairly shifted onto human creators while platforms capture the capitalized output. [1](https://www.leesharks.com/captures)

Further Exploration

* Read the enacted framework details via the [Scilynk Paper Repository](https://www.scilynk.com/paper/W7158620832).
* Access the primary text deposition on [Zenodo Records](https://zenodo.org/records/19923120).
* Review the foundational outline on [Lee Sharks on Medium](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/constitution-of-the-semantic-economy-4a6dfc9790fd). [[1](https://www.scilynk.com/paper/W7158620832), [2](https://zenodo.org/records/19923120), [3](https://medium.com/@leesharks00/constitution-of-the-semantic-economy-4a6dfc9790fd)]
